summary: Frontend-only print template verification for VoucherKu. Logged in as admin, tested both individual voucher print (VoucherManagement detail dialog -> Cetak Voucher) and bulk print (CreateVoucher). Under print media emulation, [data-testid='print-template'] and [data-testid='print-voucher-card'] render at ~302px wide (80mm), contain all required texts (Toko/ANEKA/MANGON/VOUCHER BELANJA/NILAI VOUCHER/Rp./BERLAKU SAMPAI), QR image loads (naturalWidth=250), expiry shows in uppercase Indonesian (e.g. '31 DESEMBER 2026'). window.print() was successfully triggered by both 'Cetak Voucher' and 'Cetak Semua' buttons (stubbed and asserted). In screen media, print templates are display:none. Bulk mode: 2 cards rendered inside [data-testid='print-area'], first card has page-break-after: always. Visual screenshot confirms layout matches reference design (black ribbon with notches, black rounded terms banner, bordered expiry box with calendar icon). No JS errors on print flows.
critical_code_review_comments: PrintVoucher.js: 'Rp.' formatting uses period+space omitted — matches reference. OK.
VoucherManagement.js handlePrint uses setTimeout(300ms) then window.print — works but relies on selectedVoucher state having propagated; consider guarding with a useEffect for large lists.
CreateVoucher print-area uses inline display:none but CSS @media print flips it via display:block !important — verified working under print emulation.
Minor a11y: Dialog missing aria-describedby (React warning in console).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST vouchers ('Bulk Print Test', Rp25.000, exp 2027-12-31, qty=2) via /admin/vouchers/create for bulk print verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Print template is now a shared component /app/frontend/src/components/PrintVoucher.js used by both VoucherManagement and CreateVoucher. Both flows verified via page.emulate_media('print'). QR images render as base64 PNG, expiry formatted uppercase Indonesian. window.print stub via add_init_script works to confirm print trigger without opening OS dialog.
